purpose: Define mandatory high-value quality dimensions for both the factory itself and the applications generated by the factory.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Validation
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Every factory run must have deterministic validators, explicit pass/fail results, and reviewable validation reports.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Evaluation
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Agent, workflow, prompt, and generated-output quality must be evaluated against acceptance criteria, not only syntax or test execution.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Observability
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Factory runs must emit structured audit events and should evolve toward traces, metrics, logs, run IDs, agent IDs, workflow step IDs, and failure classifications.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Traceability
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Every important output must link to requirement IDs, task IDs, policy IDs, evidence references, and producing agent/workflow steps.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Provenance and auditability
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated artifacts must preserve origin, hash, run context, validation evidence, and known limitations.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Security and AI safety
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Prompt injection, insecure outputs, excessive agency, mock-boundary confusion, secret exposure, and unapproved production actions must be explicitly guarded.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Workflow resilience
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Workflows must model checkpoints, blocked states, resume metadata, validation gates, and human-review placeholders.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Debuggability
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Factory outputs and scripts must be beginner-readable, debug-friendly, deterministic where possible, and easy to inspect from terminal output.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Operational readiness
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Runs should include supportability notes, runbooks, failure diagnosis paths, and clear next-safe-command guidance.

factory_quality_dimensions.name: Human review and approval
factory_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: The factory must not merge, tag, release, or claim completion without evidence and human-review readiness where appropriate.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Functional correctness
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated application behavior must satisfy requirement-backed positive, negative, and edge-case scenarios.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: API and data contracts
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated APIs, models, schemas, and error contracts must be explicit, typed, and testable.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Input and business validation
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Inputs, state transitions, business rules, and mock-boundary assumptions must be validated explicitly.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Testability and regression coverage
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications must include unit/API/contract/boundary/regression tests with clear acceptance criteria.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Application evaluation
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated application quality must be evaluated for functional fit, clarity, maintainability, operational readiness, and domain-risk assumptions.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Application observability
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications should expose health/readiness checks and evolve toward structured logs, trace IDs, metrics, and actionable failure signals.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Application security
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications must avoid unsafe defaults, validate inputs, avoid secret leakage, and preserve mock boundaries for out-of-scope systems.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Reliability and resilience
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications should define safe error handling, idempotency expectations, retries only where safe, and failure-mode behavior.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Performance and resource awareness
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications should avoid unnecessary complexity and document performance assumptions, especially for local CPU-only execution.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Maintainability
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated code must be beginner-readable, debug-friendly, modular, and easy to replace or extend.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Application operational readiness
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications should include startup, validation, troubleshooting, and support notes.

generated_application_quality_dimensions.name: Compliance and mock boundaries
generated_application_quality_dimensions.minimum_expectation: Generated applications must clearly distinguish official facts from synthetic assumptions and preserve honesty labels.
